content: Jesús sogsagusad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg ayaroye
Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi-nomaigua, e-sapin-wargwen ega sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, akwamar bule-burwi be dake, degi, negmar yeerdaklebalid.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Bela we-neg-dummagan be dakedi, e-akwa-dummagan bipisaale gwagwensaar birgin-birgin bar sigosulid, bela egwallegoedbiid.
Neg-bergued-iduar neg-wilubgan-oyolegoed
A-sorbali, Jesús Olivo-yargi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-asabin sigdapid. Geb Pedro, Jacobo, Juan, degi, Andrés, bachikii ese egichiarmalad:
—Be anmarga soge, ¿sanagwadse we-ibmar guoe? ¿Ibi-wilubgan oyoledagosunna, adi, oyogega bela we-ibmarmar gusokarye?
Jesús, abin-sogdegu, amarga sogded: —Nue salakarmar, mer dulemar be-yardaked be-imakmalo.
”Ar bukidar yamo anyob na imaknonimaloed. ”Sognonimaloed: ‘Ani an Cristoʼye,’ dulemar-bukidar ese yardaklemaloed.
”Bemar bila-onolenaiye itoardibe, degi, bila-onoleged-daniye be itoarmardibe, mer be gwayemalo. ”Ar weyob ibmarmar gugwelergebed, degi-inigwele, amba yoo negdi bergued-moed.

”Dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad na muchub-muchub bila-ononanai gudamaloed, degi, reymar na muchub-muchub egi-yolenanai gudamarbaloed. ”Bela yar-baid-baidgi negabandur-dummagan nagumai gudagoed. Ukud-dummad nagubaloed. ”We-ibagan-bulegan, igi ome gebe e-bonigan-nunmaked-itoardaedyobi guoed.

”Ar bemardi nue salakarmar. Ar dulemar dulemar-igar-nabiromaladga bemar-ukmaloed, degi, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggine sabsur be-bibyomarbaloed. An-nug-ulale, dummagan-negdakmamaid-asabin, degi, reymar-asabin be-sedmaloed, adi, bemar angi amarga sunmakmalagar.
Degi-inigwele, bela bin dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmaladga Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmaklegwelergebed.

”Ar bemar-gasmalale, degi, bemarga igar-itolealile, mer bukib binsamalo, ibu an sogodibeye. Unnila Bab-Dummad-bega-binsaed-ukoed be sogmaloed. Ar ade, bemar sunmakosulid, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled bemar-ular sunmakoed.
”Oburgwega na gwenadgan muchub-muchub-urmaknanai gumaloed. Bab, na mimmigi-aibinnai guoed. Mimmigan, babgangi gwisgunai gumaloed, degi, na oburgwemaloed.
Bela dulemar an-nug-ulale, isdar-be-dakmaloed. Ar we-ibmar-berguedse dule-gwen-sikirmaksasuliddina, bendaklegoed.

”Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Daniel, weyob narmaksad: ‘Bemar Bab-Dummadga bela-bela-ibmar-isgana-guedi Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi sige-wilubsulinadgi sii be dakalile, bemar Judea-yargi-gudimalad, be yalaganba wakinmarsun.’ Daniel 9:27; 11:31
”Dule-neg-uas-birgi-siid mer aidedago, deginbali, ibmar-oniega mer be negyaba dogbalo.
Dule-sapurba-gudiid, mor-sudagega mer gannar negse dago.
Ar omegan-gurgin-nika-gudidimalad, degi, a-ibagangi mimmigan-gwaru-onunanaimalad, duledar-wilesmar.
Bab-Dummadse be gormala, adi, we-ibagan-bulegan mer dii-wied-niigi guegar.
Ar a-ibagan, naibi-dummad-itoleged-ibaganad. Ayobi, Bab-Dummad-neg-obinnisad-akar, emi-ibadse, dulemar bela-bela wiledisurmalad. A-sorbali, ayobi, bar gannar wilemalosurbalid.
Ar Bab-Dummad, a-ibagan giar imaksasulina, dule gwen durguosulinad. Ar Bab-Dummad na e-sordamar-susad-ulale, a-ibagan giar nasiksad.
Degisoggu, dule-wargwen bemarga sokardibe: ‘Be dakena, wegi Cristo gudii, igidibe, weba Cristo gudii,’ mer be itomalo.

Ar ade, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duleyob, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedyob dulemar nonimaloed. Amar dulemar-yardakega galagwensuli ibmar-wilubgan, degi, ibmar-dakledisurmalad imakdamaloed. Amba Bab-Dummad-na-dulemar-susmaladse-bakar, sunna ese yardaklesmalaled.
Degisoggu, nue salakarmar, an bato iduakwaa bela bemarga ibmar sogsad.”
Jesús-gannar-danikoed
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar a-ibagangine, a-ibagan-naibi-itoleged-sorbali,
”Geb degine, ani Dule-Machi, mogir-imbaba bela-bela-ganguedba, degi, bela-bela-yeerdaklegedba dani dakdamaloed.
Geb degi, an-baliwiturmar bela napneg-ugakaase, degi, nibneg-ugakaase, an-sordamar-nugsalesmalad anga weenaega an barmidoed.
”Sapi-higuera-e-wilubgangi we-ibmar be durdakmar: Ar e-anagan dudumaksale, degi, e-gagan aramaksale, bemar nue-wisid bato yor omodanikid.
Amba deyobmodo, bemar we-ibmarmar an-bemarga-sogsad deyob guar bemar dakalir, bemar wisdo, gannar an-danikid bato nue omosad.
Napira an bemarga soged, we-dulemar-emi-dula-gudimalad-burgwed-idu, we-ibmarmar bela guedsegad.
Nibneg, degi, napneg, bela berguoed. An-gayaburbadi bipisaar berguosulid, degisadeguoed.
”Ar an-danikoed-ibadi, degi, e-wachidi, dule gwen wissulid. Amba baliwiturmar-nibneggi-bukwamaladse-bakar wissurmalad. Anse bakale, an wissurmogad. Unnila Bab-Dummadbi wisid.
Degisoggu, nue atakmar, guagwar ambikumar, gatik Babse gormar, ar ade, bemar wissulid sanagwadse an danikoe.
”Ar dule-wargwen neggwebur-baidse nasokaliyob gued. A-dule, ega-neg-akwemalaga e-neg obesnaded. Ega-arbamaladga arbaed uksa naded. Yawagak-dakedga nue-nakulegoye sogsa naded.
Degisoggu, mer gabmalo, ar be wissurmalad sanagwadse dummad-neg-ibed danikoe. Neg-sedogwendibe, neggabgwendibe, gebe-gannir-namakedgindibe, wakdardibe, bemar wissulid.
Ar ade, ukiagwar bemargi danikir, mer gabmai bemar-dakegar.
An bemarga sogedi, an bela dule-bamaladga sogmogad: ¡Mer gabmalo, nue nakulemalo!”
